Hello {name},

Your account has been created by your doctor. A temporary password has been communicated to you.

You will be asked to change it on first login.

Login here: {url}

Your password has been reset by your doctor.

You will be asked to change it on next login.

Hello {name},

email.verifyEmailBody:
Welcome to HealthBridge!

Please verify your email address by clicking the link below:

{url}

This link will expire in 24 hours.

If you did not create an account, please ignore this email.
